metadata.description: Claude plugins for MentionedOn, Intakra, Soxoa, Postedly, Portravo and Ocolta. Each plugin pairs the product's remote MCP server with skills that teach Claude how to use it.

plugins.name: mentionedon
plugins.description: Grade AI-discovery evidence you supply and turn it into a prioritized visibility plan.

plugins.name: intakra
plugins.description: Score caller-supplied buying-signal evidence and prepare why-now reviews for a human.

plugins.name: soxoa
plugins.description: Estimate illustrative automation ROI and rank workflows for automate, assist, or discovery.

plugins.name: postedly
plugins.description: Send real faxes, letters, certified mail, postcards and handwritten cards, with browser approval before payment.

plugins.name: portravo
plugins.description: Turn construction plan PDFs into reviewed takeoffs and Excel estimates in your Portravo account.

plugins.name: ocolta
plugins.description: Read categorical summaries from your recoverable Ocolta Deep Reviews and plan fair document-verification follow-up.
